This application requires an internet connection to access multimedia data (photos, videos, and audio) and the list of applications. It is used to read and write photos, videos, audio, and other types of files stored on the device and to manage them, as well as to display application icons for different files. During use, it accesses location information for the QR-code quick transfer function to obtain network information for file transfer. The collection and use of the above personal information is triggered only when specific business functions are used. \n\nPlease read %1$s to learn more about our rules for handling your personal information. Android 11 file read / write permission change description

Due to Google\'s new file storage and reading rules in Android 11 version, affected by this:\nAndroid / data and OBB directory files, system and third-party file management can not read, write and display.\nTherefore, the path entrance is hidden and not displayed.
The changes made to domestic users using Android 11 version are as follows:
1. Through the file management - all files entry, enter the Android directory, file management can\'t read, display and operate the files in the data and OBB directory.
2. The original wechat, QQ directly open the document, need to save the file, in the file management view management.
3. Important files of third-party applications can be saved manually or downloaded to local to view and manage.
4. File management is unable to search, display and operate files in related directories.
